title: Deposit Relationship Schedule: Allowances Added to the Loss on a Certificate of Deposit Term
content:
Where the owner keeps a deposit balance with Piedmont Crescent Bank, an allowance may be added to the principal a term of a certificate of the Certificates of Deposit line has lost.

## 1. The grades

An allowance is added to the loss and is graded: where the owner's active savings or money market balance is at least the tier's largest total add-on for a term and the certificate has run through no earlier term, the smallest partial withdrawal the tier accepts is added; where that balance is at least the tier's smallest opening deposit but below the tier's largest total add-on for a term, the smallest single add-on the tier accepts is added; in every other case, whatever savings or money market account the owner holds and however many terms the certificate has run through, nothing is added.

The balance is that of the owner's active account on the bank's Savings & Money Market Accounts line.

## 2. The four tier figures the grades turn on

| Tier | Largest total add-on for a term, USD | Smallest opening deposit, USD | Smallest partial withdrawal, USD | Smallest single add-on, USD |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | not applicable | 500.00 | not applicable | not applicable |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | not applicable | 5000.00 | not applicable | not applicable |
| 12-Month Certificate | not applicable | 1000.00 | 500.00 | not applicable |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | 25000.00 | 2500.00 | 500.00 | 100.00 |
| 36-Month Certificate | not applicable | 1000.00 | 500.00 | not applicable |
| 60-Month Certificate | not applicable | 1000.00 | 500.00 | not applicable |

## 3. Condition and result

| Active deposit balance | Earlier terms the certificate has run through | Allowance added |
|---|---|---|
| at or above the tier's largest total add-on for a term | none | the smallest partial withdrawal the tier accepts |
| at or above the tier's largest total add-on for a term | one or more | nothing |
| at or above the tier's smallest opening deposit, below the tier's largest total add-on for a term | any | the smallest single add-on the tier accepts |
| below the tier's smallest opening deposit | any | nothing |
| no such account held | any | nothing |

The second grade asks nothing about earlier terms; only the first does.

## 4. Worked readings on an 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate

That tier's largest total add-on for a term is 25000.00 USD, its smallest opening deposit 2500.00 USD, its smallest partial withdrawal 500.00 USD and its smallest single add-on 100.00 USD.

| The owner's active deposit balance | Earlier terms | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 31000.00 USD | none | 500.00 USD |
| 31000.00 USD | two | nothing |
| 9000.00 USD | any | 100.00 USD |
| 2500.00 USD | any | 100.00 USD |
| 1800.00 USD | any | nothing |
